title: Machine learning guides discovery of hard Fe–Nb–B metallic-glass films
summary: Random-forest models for glass formation and hardness helped select Fe–Nb–B composition regions for sputtered-film experiments. The study reports a maximum measured hardness of 29 GPa for Fe₃Nb₂₅B₇₂ and an H/E ratio of 0.09 for Fe₂₀Nb₁₂B₆₈. H/E is used as an estimate of wear resistance, not a direct wear test. Samples were 500–800 nm films with substrate-effect corrections; bulk properties and industrial production were not demonstrated. This extends earlier machine-learning/high-throughput work on metallic glasses and is one study.
